name: Manual Position Tracking Panel
summary: This EA is a manual position tracking panel that provides a visual dashboard for monitoring and managing open positions. It does not open trades on its own but serves as an informational and management overlay on the chart. The panel tracks profit/loss, position details, and offers quick-close or modification capabilities for the trader.
summary_zh: 这是一个手动持仓跟踪面板EA，提供可视化仪表板用于监控和管理持仓。它不会自主开仓，而是作为图表上的信息和管理叠加层，跟踪盈亏、持仓详情，并提供快速平仓或修改功能。
strategy_analysis: 此EA并非自动交易策略，而是一个持仓管理工具面板。它没有入场条件或出场条件，因为它不自主开仓或平仓。仓位管理方面，面板仅显示当前持仓信息，可能提供一键平仓或部分平仓功能。资金管理方面，它不涉及自动资金分配，但可能展示账户余额、净值和保证金使用率等关键数据供交易者参考。面板的核心价值在于将分散的持仓信息集中展示，帮助交易者快速做出决策。它可能包含按品种、方向或魔术号分组汇总盈亏的功能。由于不涉及自动交易逻辑，风险主要来自于手动操作时的误点击或面板按钮逻辑错误。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA is not an automated trading strategy but a position management utility panel. It has no entry or exit conditions since it does not autonomously open or close trades. For position management, the panel only displays current position information and may offer one-click close or partial close functionality. Regarding money management, it does not involve automatic capital allocation but may display key account data such as balance, equity, and margin usage for the trader's reference. The core value of the panel lies in consolidating scattered position information into a centralized view, helping traders make quick decisions. It may include grouping and summarizing profit/loss by symbol, direction, or magic number. Since it does not involve automated trading logic, the primary risks come from accidental clicks during manual operation or logical errors in panel button functionality.
pros: 将所有持仓信息集中展示，提升交易者的决策效率
提供一键平仓或部分平仓功能，减少手动操作延迟
可视化盈亏汇总，便于快速评估账户整体风险状况
pros_en: Consolidates all position information into one view, improving trader decision-making efficiency
Provides one-click close or partial close functionality, reducing manual operation latency
Visual profit/loss summary enables quick assessment of overall account risk status
cons: 仅作为辅助工具，不提供自动交易信号或策略执行
面板可能占用图表空间，影响价格分析和指标观察
依赖手动操作，无法在交易者不在时自动管理持仓风险
cons_en: Only serves as an auxiliary tool, does not provide automated trading signals or strategy execution
Panel may occupy chart space, interfering with price analysis and indicator observation
Relies on manual operation, cannot automatically manage position risk when the trader is absent
improvements: 增加声音或推送通知功能，当持仓盈亏达到设定阈值时提醒交易者
添加按策略或魔术号分组的盈亏统计和历史交易回顾功能
improvements_en: Add sound or push notification functionality to alert the trader when position P&L reaches a set threshold
Add P&L statistics grouped by strategy or magic number and historical trade review functionality

risk_points: 面板按钮误操作可能导致意外平仓
频繁刷新面板数据可能增加终端资源消耗
risk_points_en: Accidental panel button clicks may cause unintended position closures
Frequent panel data refresh may increase terminal resource consumption

It does not open trades on its own but serves as an informational and management overlay on the chart. The panel tracks profit/loss, position details, and offers quick-close or modification capabilities for the trader.
